_doc: Corrections to data/catalog.json, by catalogue id; they always win over the sources (the control panel writes its own decisions to catalog.admin.json next to the catalogue). Typical uses: {"<id>": {"gog": "https://www.gog.com/en/game/..."}} for a missing or wrong shop link; {"<id>": {"status": "record"}} to keep a game as record only; {"<id>": {"editions": {"<edition key>": {"approved": true, "rights": "permission"}}}} to make an edition available on the web (the person deciding takes care of the authorisation), or {"run": {"exe": "GAME/START.BAT", "cycles": 20000}} to fix how it starts.
